name: old_episodes_findings
source: Two earlier Worth Telling episodes sent 3 Nov 2026: the red paperclip (55 s) and the Victoria Hall doors (108 s)
speakers: Every line measures as the same voice, Ozzy's 'Toys? Everybody downstairs.' included. The three hosts shared one voice.
closest_microsoft_voices: en-AU-WilliamMultilingual, en-CA-Liam, en-GB-Ryan and en-US-Christopher, all within 0.01 of each other, so none is a confident match
faults_heard_by_transcription: the article 'a' is often spoken as the letter 'ay': 'a gap' came out as 'eye gap', 'a theatre' as 'iTheatre', 'one child at a time' as 'one child at eye time', 'a man tore' as 'I manned tore'
the three hosts are not told apart by sound, so the dialogue reads as one narrator talking to himself
rules_for_new_cast: each host at least 4 semitones from the others, or a clearly different accent
every shortlisted voice is tested on a line full of 'a' words and must say them as 'uh'

ozzy_line.where: Victoria Hall episode, 27.6 s to 29.9 s
ozzy_line.same_voice_as_ren: yes: voiceprint 0.83 against Ren's lines, inside the 0.68 to 0.85 range Ren's own lines score against each other; pitch median 105 Hz against Ren's 117 Hz
ozzy_line.delivery: 'Toys?' said flat and falling (113 to 87 Hz), 0.3 s beat, then 'Everybody downstairs' jumping to 150 to 175 Hz and dropping: the crowd's thought, said for them
ozzy_line.keep_for_new_ozzy: two to four words, a beat, then the punch on the stressed word; a voice of his own, at least 4 semitones from Ren or with a different accent
